description: GAP-A-4 T7 — Bratteli/Markov stabilization candidate functor H_3 → H_5 via σ_1,σ_2 ↪. Tests whether the H-sector trace contribution carries the Borromean h⁴ = −3/4 cleanly. Verdict: REFUTED — structural ratio is 5/4 (not 1).

bratteli_structural_ratio.verdict: Bratteli/Markov stabilization functor REFUTED — the structural ratio is uniformly 5/4 (not 1), so the H-sector h⁴ transfer would be −15/16, not −3/4.  Recovering −3/4 requires an ad-hoc rescaling by 4/5 that has no derivation in the framework.  This is the 4th candidate functor refuted (after T5 F1/F2/F3).

data.synthesis_verdict: Bratteli/Markov stabilization functor F: H_3 → H_5 picks up the Borromean trace at the H-sector with a uniform multiplier 5/4 at q=1 — confirmed for BOTH the χ^{(2,1)}-coefficient (5/6 vs 2/3) AND the writhe-0 constant term (5/12 vs 1/3). So the H-sector h⁴ contribution would be (5/4)·(−3/4) = −15/16, NOT −3/4. Recovering −3/4 cleanly requires an ad-hoc rescaling by 4/5 with no framework-internal derivation — Bratteli stabilization is the 4th candidate functor REFUTED (after T5's F1/F2/F3 and T6's H-sector self-h⁴ = +2). The 5/4 factor itself is structurally interesting (it equals the per-irrep Plancherel weight ratio and the multiplicity-4 normalisation from T5 F1), but it is NOT the obvious bridge the audit's missing functor demands. RT / q-Schur duality (T8 follow-up) remains untested.
